# Firmware third-party notices

`esp-idf-5.5.4/` preserves license and notice files from the SDK used to build
the bundled Multi-Hop firmware: ESP-IDF, Espressif radio libraries, NimBLE,
TinyCrypt, FreeRTOS, lwIP, Mbed TLS, newlib/picolibc, WPA supplicant, and micro-ecc.
Paths mirror the SDK tree. These notices cover their respective dependencies;
they do not assign a license to this project's own source.

SDK source: https://github.com/espressif/esp-idf/tree/v5.5.4

The optional AI fonts and emoji retain their notices in their own asset folders.
